violations.description: General employee cleanliness. — --Food employee did not wash hands as necessary. Employee observed moving clean dishes after handling soiled dishes without washing hands before. Hands must be washed whenever handling clean dishes after other tasks.

Preventing contamination by employees. — --Employee observed using same pair of single-use gloves for more than one task. Employee observed using the same pair of gloves for food prep, handheld device use, and stocking product. Single use gloves must be changed between tasks.

Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Surface of equipment/utensil did not reach minimum temperature of 160F during hot water sanitize rinse of warewash machine. After three runs of the warewash machine the highest observed surface temperature was 157F. Warewash machine must reach a surface temperature for utensils of 160F for proper sanitation.

Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Sanitize solution for mechanical warewashing machine was not maintained at the proper concentration. - Dishwasher tested at 0 ppm QA during inspection. Drained and refilled machine several times with no luck. Tried CHL & Lactic Acid test strips as well. Manager put in a maintenance ticket right away and is having staff hand wash everything until fixed.
